Politics · India

DMK MLA Udhayanidhi Stalin detained over alleged remarks against actor Trisha and CM Vijay

DMK leader and Tamil Nadu Opposition Leader Udhayanidhi Stalin was detained from his Chennai residence on Tuesday. The detention is in connection with an FIR registered over alleged indecent and double-meaning remarks made during a rally on the Cauvery dispute in Thanjavur on Monday. The complaints include allegations that the remarks were directed at an actor. The Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) filed a complaint, leading to the case. Udhayanidhi Stalin was later granted bail.
